changelog:
Initial release of Text Case Converter.

- Converts text between various case formats: UPPER, lower, Title, Sentence, camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, and CONSTANT_CASE.
- Pure Python implementation; does not require an API key.
- Includes command-line usage examples and a feature overview.
- Provides documentation in both English and Chinese.
